source: During full-sequence training, all token positions are processed in parallel. There is no long-lived serving cache that must survive across one-token decode iterations. Attention still consumes activation memory and bandwidth, but the persistent KV-cache problem is specifically an inference concern.
zh: 在全序列训练期间，所有令牌位置都是并行处理的。不存在必须在单令牌解码迭代中生存的长期服务缓存。注意力仍然消耗激活内存和带宽，但持久的 KV 缓存问题特别是推理问题。
